dedupe_keys.name: input data and backbone modelling files for the finnish power system with an embedded hydropower cascade

description: Input data and Backbone modelling files for the Finnish power system with an embedded hydropower cascade is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Julia Kiehle, Tomi Lindroos (University of Oulu). The files show the input data and modelling files used for the publication "Cascade hydropower integration in a techno-economic power system model: A study of Finnish hydropower plants" (Kiehle et al. - under review). A model of the Finnish energy system in 2022 was built in the techno-economic modelling framework Backbone. Coverage: national (FI); the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
